annotations.title: Find the best options to buy

description: Find the best real options to buy a product, ranked only by what is best for the buyer (never by who pays). Returns store, price, shipping, when the price was checked, why each option ranks where it does, and a buy link. Works for any product sold online in the US; stores are added in more categories every week (today: fragrance and beauty). If a category is not compared yet, it says so instead of guessing.

language.description: Language for the answer (default: the language of the query).

query.description: What the user wants, in their own words. Example: "Versace Eros eau de toilette 3.4 oz under $80" or "perfume fresco para hombre menos de $60".
